lines: A weapon is honest about harm. People should try being that honest before causing it.
Good. Now keep your temper sheathed unless the village needs it drawn.
Harm is easy to make and hard to take back. At least you know which you did.
I hear the apology. I am still judging what follows it.
Trust takes longer to repair than steel.
Give me room after this. Forgiveness does not mean I have lowered my guard.
Actions will tell me whether the words were sound.
Regret is the heat. Change is the hammer work.
Some damage leaves a mark even after the repair holds.
I accept that you are trying to make this right.
Do not polish the apology until it stops sounding honest.
I need time before I put this matter away.
A clean admission is better than another excuse.
You named the harm. Now stop repeating it.
I believe you are sorry. I do not trust you yet.
The next few days matter more than this one speech.
An apology begins the repair. It does not finish it.
Keep your hands calm and your promises smaller.
I will meet you halfway when your actions do.
We are done talking for now. Let the work prove the rest.
